description: Life-stage based adjustments for health insurance recommendation needs.

young_unmarried.description: Individual who has started working and usually has fewer dependents.

high_sum_insured.reason: Early purchase can help build stronger long-term health protection.
high_sum_insured.customer_friendly_reason: Starting with adequate cover early can protect you from future medical cost increases.

wellness.reason: Young customers often value preventive health and wellness-linked benefits.
wellness.customer_friendly_reason: Wellness benefits may reward healthy habits and preventive checkups.

room_rent_flexibility.reason: Room flexibility is useful but not usually the highest priority at this stage.
room_rent_flexibility.customer_friendly_reason: Some flexibility in room choice can help during hospitalization.

married_planning_family.description: Married customer or couple likely to plan children in the near future.

maternity_or_newborn.reason: Maternity and newborn benefits become highly relevant for family planning.
maternity_or_newborn.customer_friendly_reason: If you are planning a family, maternity and newborn-related benefits become important.

low_waiting_period.reason: Waiting periods matter because maternity and some disease benefits may not be immediately available.
low_waiting_period.customer_friendly_reason: Lower waiting periods may help you use important benefits sooner.

high_sum_insured.reason: Family responsibilities increase the need for stronger health protection.
high_sum_insured.customer_friendly_reason: A higher cover can be useful as your family responsibilities grow.

wellness.reason: Preventive care and wellness benefits are useful for young families.
wellness.customer_friendly_reason: Wellness benefits may support preventive health for the family.

avoid_copay.customer_friendly_reason: Lower or no co-pay can reduce your share of claim expenses.

room_rent_flexibility.reason: Family hospitalization in metro or private hospitals can make room rent flexibility useful.
room_rent_flexibility.customer_friendly_reason: Room rent flexibility can help avoid restrictions during hospitalization.

family_with_kids.description: Customer with dependent children and higher family health protection needs.

high_sum_insured.reason: Family floater policies need adequate cover for multiple members.
high_sum_insured.customer_friendly_reason: With children, a higher family cover can help protect everyone better.

wellness.reason: Wellness and preventive care are useful for family health management.
wellness.customer_friendly_reason: Wellness benefits may support regular health checkups and preventive care.

avoid_copay.reason: Avoiding co-pay reduces out-of-pocket uncertainty during family claims.
avoid_copay.customer_friendly_reason: No or lower co-pay can reduce your share of claim expenses.

low_waiting_period.reason: Lower waiting periods improve usability of benefits for family members.
low_waiting_period.customer_friendly_reason: Lower waiting periods can make policy benefits usable sooner.

room_rent_flexibility.reason: Room rent flexibility can matter during hospitalization of any family member.
room_rent_flexibility.customer_friendly_reason: Room flexibility can help you choose suitable hospital accommodation.

retired_senior.description: Retired or senior citizen customer with higher claim probability and cost sensitivity.

avoid_copay.reason: Co-pay can materially increase out-of-pocket expenses for senior citizens.
avoid_copay.customer_friendly_reason: For seniors, avoiding co-pay can reduce claim-time expenses.

low_waiting_period.reason: Existing conditions and age-related illnesses make waiting periods very important.
low_waiting_period.customer_friendly_reason: Lower waiting periods may help you access important benefits sooner.

room_rent_flexibility.reason: Room restrictions can significantly affect claim payout in senior hospitalization.
room_rent_flexibility.customer_friendly_reason: Room rent flexibility can reduce claim deductions linked to room category.

high_sum_insured.reason: Senior healthcare costs can be high, but affordability must be checked.
high_sum_insured.customer_friendly_reason: A higher cover may help with larger medical expenses, subject to affordability.

wellness.reason: Wellness is useful but core hospitalization conditions are higher priority for seniors.
wellness.customer_friendly_reason: Wellness benefits are useful, but claim conditions matter more.
